name: andv_public_health
remarks: ANDV Public Health Overlay Submodule
Encodes the public-health response events that accompany confirmed/probable
Andes virus cases: isolation, PPE, contact tracing, and 42-day monitoring.
This submodule is called for ALL patients who reach clinical diagnosis
(both HCPS survivors and ward-level patients). It overlays outbreak-management
workflows onto the synthetic record, not just bedside clinical care.
Key interventions encoded:
- Single-room isolation with airborne/enhanced contact precautions
(CDC 2026 HAN: AIIR + N95 respirator, gown, gloves, eye protection)
- Mandatory public health notification
- 42-day contact monitoring period (per CDC/WHO/ECDC guidance)
- Contact tracing status tracked as patient attribute
Attributes set:
andv_contact_tracing_status : 'initiated' → 'completed'
andv_isolation_active        : true → false
SNOMED codes marked 'verify' need confirmation against current release.
